title: Thrush (bird)
blurb: The thrushes are a passerine bird family, Turdidae, with a worldwide distribution.
facts: Thrushes are small to medium-sized ground living birds that feed on insects, other invertebrates, and fruit.
Some unrelated species around the world have been named after thrushes due to their similarity to birds in this family.
